sections.title: Case detail handler
sections.what: Gathers a case's detail along with related verification, guidance, timeline, packets, and government status. Chooses the display language from a header.
sections.why: Likely reason: one request gives the page everything it needs.
sections.watch_out: Only the two language codes hi and en are recognized, so any other value falls back to English.

summary: Web address that returns the full detail of one case, including documents, verification, guidance, timeline, and government process status.
purpose: Gives the case page its main data in one request.
why: Likely reason: a single call keeps the case page simple and consistent.
how: Reads the case id and the optional language header, where only hi or en are accepted. It makes sure seed documents exist, loads the case, and returns 404 if it is missing. Otherwise it adds verification, guidance, timeline, packets, and adapter information. The remaining logic is cut off in the source.
inputs: Case id in the address and an optional x-bhoomi-locale header.
outputs: Case detail data, or a 404 with code CASE_NOT_FOUND.
risks: The main logic is one long line cut off in the source, so the verification behavior is confirmed only through the test.
debug: A 404 means the case id is wrong. If guidance or timeline is missing, check the matching service.
